_doc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending. Reinterp opening beats O1–O3 (docs/REINTERP_OPENING_AND_FLOW_SPEC_2026-07-03.md §1, behind ?reinterp=1 only). R26 adds the missing cork-board lineage: the same rear-wall surface starts as O3's warm pinned profile board, then hardens into the cold witness record. Register/intent ONLY — every line is a demonstration, not final copy; §0-REV register direction is 'more direct and controlling — the player is forced, limited, demanded of', and every demand is diegetic (the OS's voice, never the piece's). Per spec §5.1 the O3 icon/chip/goal SETS below are register demonstrations, not the final selection — Sérgio picks the final set (criterion: each chip must be able to RETURN, recontextualised, in the witness record or an assistant line). o3_prefilled_name is a placeholder for the 'they already know your name' beat (never typed). The Lamby boot chime + logo are Sérgio's assets, wired as placeholder slots here.
o1_disclaimer: This work depicts how organised 'conversion' networks target queer people online.
It reproduces the tactics of that apparatus — its cheer, its forms, its filing — so they can be seen. Nothing here is advice, treatment, or endorsement.
Some moments may be difficult. You can leave at any time; nothing you do is kept.
A production of SurvivingSOGICE — University of Bergen, Center for Digital Narrative.
